Normal SVM source trainers use all unpruned raw columns; no ordinary-path 132-column freeze was introduced. The isolated research runner retains its separately declared fixed schema.
Eight Open-known fields bypass the ordinary dataset shift. Thirteen close-known fields use canonical prior-session alignment, preserving legacy feature and label behavior.
Live rebuilding uses the same morning core for every present, unpruned dip field; excluded fields are omitted by model selection as for other ordinary features.
MRCY is retained in ordinary source fixtures and all 1,008 frozen panel model dates. No MRCY-specific exclusion added.
Shared XNYS adapter inserts absent exchange sessions with NaNs; supplied original row keys are retained.
The research decision-aligned core remains unchanged; ordinary snapshot adapter advances close-known fields once using an empty future placeholder, without using future HLCV.
Dataset canonical shift marks missing-session low-history coverage as 0, while other unavailable measurements remain NaN.
Scalar helper validates full history before retaining only the required 252 canonical rows and extends missing dates through the day before entry.
Seven real-date pipeline mutations of current/future HLCV and future Open do not alter current inputs; seven live rows agree with frozen research values.
Holiday/timezone/DST contracts have focused tests; market basis and supplied non-XNYS rows remain explicit caller responsibilities.
Shared Yahoo default and nightly stock refresh request 2y with existing auto_adjust=False. SPY/VIX refresh explicitly uses the same period.
Every family computes on full available price history; one calendar year of completed snapshots is retained only after composition, across every column together.
Ordinary price files are not replaced with the isolated five-year research cache.
Independent actual-calendar fixture has 501 input sessions, 251 retained snapshot rows, 250 labeled rows. Retained output equals untrimmed computation exactly.
history_retention_review.limitation: Two calendar years can leave a few earliest retained dates with fewer than 252 preceding sessions. In this MRCY fixture only the first labeled day 2025-11-10 lacks 252-bar coverage; validity stays 0 and long-low fields remain NaN. New listings/provider gaps can have more unknown history.

No double shift, current/future HLCV leak, compressed missing-session lookback or unknown-flag false fill.
No research-price splice, extension of stored training span to two years, hidden source whitelist or bypass of explicit prune list.
No verifier production data/model writes or intervention in scheduled nightly.
Core formulas shared across research/snapshot/live adapters; timing conversion remains explicit and bounded.

code_quality_review.nonblocking_observation: Existing pandas dataframe fragmentation PerformanceWarnings appear during full pipeline dataset assembly; numerical checks succeed and no unrelated performance refactor was introduced.

deployment_review.startup_import_boundary: nightly.py imports rebuild_features and persist_training before run_nightly, so the already-running process retains previously imported schema modules.
deployment_review.termination_behavior: During fitting, previous live model files remain intact. ModelStore serializes to a temporary file, fsyncs, then atomically replaces each destination; termination during serialization can leave a temporary file but not truncate latest. Rank/Fit publication is separate, not a multi-model transaction.
deployment_review.authorization_scope: Root coordinates any deliberate supersession of obsolete nightly and subsequent same-provider refresh/features/normal training after test signoff. This verifier performs neither.

production_preservation: Scheduled nightly legitimately changed production prices/features/context since original audit; earlier 4,007-file equality is historical evidence only. This review made no production writes and did not revert scheduled changes or unrelated Jev data.
limitations: Entirely absent live price history retains the 13 close-known values of the TTL-validated snapshot and clears eight Open-known values; sparse available history receives full canonical recomputation.
Existing raw-price adjustment/corporate-action and universe-survivorship limitations remain.
No full production training or broker actions were performed; saved-model inclusion requires the subsequent normal refresh/retrain.
Official-open feature benchmark does not certify execution at that already observed opening price.
signoff: Source implementation, numerical/calendar timing, ordinary integration, anti-pattern and code-quality reviews pass. Full repository suite passes. Ready for the source milestone commit and root-coordinated same-provider two-year refresh, one-year feature snapshots, and normal retraining. Successful refresh coverage and final model artifacts must be verified after those operational steps; no predictive-value guarantee is implied.
